1.say: Check that. Viruses are not made of cells, and they are not alive.
hit: all living things are made of cells like viruses are made of cells
viruses are living things made of cells
miss: All living things are made up of cells. Cells are the basic units of structure and function. New cells are produced from existing cells.
all living things are made of cells viruses are not made of cells
viruses are not alive cells are the basic unit of life

2.say: Check that. Can a dead cell divide? What kind of cell makes new cells?
hit: new cells come from dead cells
new cells are produced from old dead cells
miss: New cells are produced from existing cells. A cell divides to make new cells.
new cells come from cells that already exist by dividing
new cells come from existing living cells not dead cells

11.say: Check that. Which level is built from the one before it?
hit: tissues are bigger than organs
cells are made of tissues and tissues make organs
miss: Cell, tissue, organ, organ system. Each level is built from the one before it.
cells make tissues tissues make organs organs make organ systems
organs are made of tissues which are made of cells
tissues are smaller than organs

12.say: Check that. An organelle is like a little organ, but where is it found?
hit: an organelle is an organ like the heart
organelles are body parts with a job
miss: An organelle is a structure inside a cell that has a specific job. The word means little organ, named after the organs in your body.
an organelle is a little organ inside a cell with a job
organelles are tiny structures in cells that do a job like organs do in your body

13.say: Check that. Do bacteria have a nucleus?
hit: the nucleus holds dna and all cells have a nucleus
every cell has a nucleus that controls it
miss: The nucleus holds the cell's DNA. It is called the control center because the DNA has the instructions that control most of the cell's activities.
the nucleus has the dna and controls the cell
not all cells have a nucleus but in eukaryotes it holds the dna

15.say: Check that. Is the cytoplasm inside or outside the cell membrane?
hit: the cytoplasm is the outer layer of the cell
cytoplasm is the fluid outside the cell membrane
miss: The cytoplasm is the fluid inside the cell membrane but outside the nucleus. The organelles sit in it. Glycolysis happens in the cytoplasm.
cytoplasm is the jelly inside the cell where glycolysis happens
it is the fluid between the membrane and the nucleus and glycolysis happens there

19.say: Check that. Where does the Golgi ship finished proteins?
hit: the golgi packages proteins and sends them to the nucleus
golgi sorts proteins and ships them into the nucleus
miss: The Golgi apparatus modifies, sorts, and packages proteins for storage or to ship out of the cell.
the golgi packages and ships proteins out of the cell in vesicles
golgi modifies and sorts proteins from the er

22.say: Check that. Does a chloroplast make light, or capture it?
hit: the chloroplast makes sunlight to make food
chloroplasts produce light energy for the plant
miss: The chloroplast captures energy from sunlight and uses it to make food (sugar). This process is photosynthesis.
chloroplasts capture light energy and make sugar by photosynthesis
it uses sunlight to make glucose in photosynthesis

23.say: Check that. Breaking down waste is the lysosome's job. What does a vacuole do?
hit: the vacuole breaks down waste and old parts
a vacuole digests food for the cell
miss: A vacuole stores materials like water, salts, proteins, and carbohydrates. A plant's large central vacuole fills with water and pushes outward, which keeps the plant firm.
the vacuole stores water and food and keeps the plant from wilting
the vacuole does not break down waste it stores water

24.re: (couldn't|could not|can't|cannot|wouldn't|would not|won't|not) (be able to )?(divide|split|reproduce|make new cells)\b
24.say: Check that. Cell division is not the lysosome's job. What would pile up?
hit: the cell would not be able to divide
if lysosomes stopped working the cell couldn't reproduce
miss: Lysosomes are filled with enzymes that break down and recycle worn-out parts and waste. If they stopped working, waste and worn-out parts would pile up inside the cell.
waste would build up because lysosomes break down old parts
the cell would fill up with junk and old organelles

24.say: Check that. Lysosomes do an important job. What would pile up without them?
hit: nothing would happen to the cell
if lysosomes stopped the cell would be fine
miss: If lysosomes stopped working, waste and worn-out parts would pile up inside the cell.
nothing would break down the waste so it would pile up
waste would build up and the cell would get clogged

30.say: Check that. Does a bacterium have a nucleus?
hit: if it has a nucleus it is a bacterium
with a nucleus then it's a prokaryote
miss: If it has a cell wall, chloroplasts, and a large central vacuole, it is a plant cell. If it has centrioles and no cell wall, it is an animal cell. If it has no nucleus and no membrane-bound organelles, it is a bacterium.
if it has no nucleus it is a bacterium
if it has a nucleus it is a plant or animal cell, if it doesn't it is a bacterium
